retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast nocturnal scene featuring a central silhouette against a large moon, framed by massive, right-aligned sans-serif typography and a starlit gradient background.
triggerTerms: silhouette sitting in a tree against a giant moon
starlit night sky with textured grain
large bold sans-serif text overlapping a moon
cosmic blue and cream color palette
excludeWhen: script or serif fonts are the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition dominated by a dark, starlit sky that transitions from deep navy to a teal-tinted horizon. A central, detailed silhouette of a tree holds a small figure, positioned directly in front of a large, glowing cream-colored moon. Massive, bold sans-serif typography is layered over the scene, primarily justified to the right, creating a tension between the vastness of space and the structure of the text.
coreVisualRelationships: The silhouette of the figure and tree is anchored by the circular glow of the moon.
Large-scale typography creates a foreground frame that overlaps the celestial background.
A vertical trail of light or rocket exhaust connects the top-right text to the horizon.
The stippled texture of the stars provides a consistent grain across the dark values.
coreInvariants: High-contrast silhouette against a circular light source
Textured stippling effect in the sky and shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The tree and figure are centered horizontally but positioned in the lower-middle third, scaled small to emphasize the scale of the moon and sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright cream moon serves as the primary focal point and light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top-right text, follows the vertical light trail down to the silhouette, and then moves across the secondary text in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The vast starlit sky in the upper left provides breathing room against the dense typography on the right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and midnight blue (background sky)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark silhouettes and the bright moon/text; low saturation overall with a focus on tonal depth.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure black; use deep indigo
Avoid pure white; use warm cream

letterConstructionRules: Integration of small icons within letter counters (e.g., rocket in 'A')
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' features a simplified rocket silhouette in its counter space.
Letters are occasionally cropped by the frame edges.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying scales and tracking to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, modern, and authoritative feel of the display text.
Open-source alternative with similar geometric proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a textured nocturnal landscape with a deep navy starlit sky transitioning to teal at the horizon. In the center, place a large glowing cream moon. In front of the moon, place a dark silhouette of a gnarled tree with a small figure sitting on a branch. Add a vertical trail of light rising from the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, right-aligned uppercase sans-serif text in cream. The main title should be large and tightly spaced in the upper right, overlapping the moon. Add a smaller subtitle in the bottom right with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the figure silhouetted against the moon?
Is the color palette restricted to navy, teal, and cream?
Is there a visible grain or stipple texture in the sky?

mustRedesign: Specific rocket icon inside the letter A

mustAchieve: Balanced weight between text and imagery
avoid: Default digital star brushes without variation

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the moon's glow.
Check that the vertical light trail aligns with the typography.
Verify the grain texture is consistent across all dark areas.
Confirm the silhouette remains sharp and recognizable.
recipe.reuseFormula: Nocturnal Silhouette + Geometric Display Type + Right-Aligned Layout + Stippled Texture
